layer_e_story_selling.selected_story_lens: Opposite tempos become a love language when his stability protects her spark and her spark makes his plan alive.

concept_diagnosis.hook: Capricorn man / Aries woman / he plans the future. / she starts it.
concept_diagnosis.reader_identity_mirror: planner partner x impulse partner couples who somehow work better together than separately
concept_diagnosis.emotional_obstacle: Their tempos look incompatible: he needs safety before motion, she creates motion before safety.
concept_diagnosis.aachu_proof: keys, booking, heart-arrow edit, fiery expression, moving away while laughing, road-pointing, balcony dancing
concept_diagnosis.zuv_active_role: plans, explains, receives the plot twist, worries softly, fixes a detail, saves screenshots, follows her instinct, smiles at the chaos, closes the notebook beside her
concept_diagnosis.bridge: the joke turns when stability and spark become mutual protection instead of opposites
concept_diagnosis.send_save_reason: Capricorn/Aries and planner/spontaneous couples can send it as their exact dynamic.

slide_copy: Marry the one who joins your nonsense.
They reply to every plot twist.
You start stories from the middle.
They ask like they were there.
Maybe love is finding someone fluent in you.
